request.raw_text: Change the current plug for Europlug with two round pins and try to copy the real shape.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Existing plug body at the free end of the power cord
areas_to_change.location: Terminal end of the external power cable, away from the appliance enclosure
areas_to_change.description: Replace the current plug body with a realistically proportioned Europlug-style molded body, approximating the recognizable CEE 7/16 form and maintaining a suitable cable strain-relief transition.

areas_to_change.location: Projecting from the free-end plug body
areas_to_change.description: Replace the existing apparent flat contacts with exactly two parallel, circular cylindrical pins arranged symmetrically at Europlug spacing and oriented for simultaneous insertion into a compatible socket.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Main appliance enclosure and rounded end geometry
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all housing dimensions, surfaces, seams, openings, and overall appearance.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: External support bracket and mounting features
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the U-shaped bracket, pivots, fasteners, and their positions.
Preserve all internal components and their placement.
Preserve the cord diameter, routing, length, and attachment to the appliance except for any minimal terminal transition needed to join the new plug body.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The power cord will terminate in a compact, realistic Europlug body carrying two symmetric, parallel round pins instead of the current plug and contact geometry.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The revised plug will visually and geometrically represent a two-pin European Type C mains connector intended for compatible European sockets.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The two round pins will enter a compatible socket together while the molded body and strain-relief region retain the cord and transfer handling loads.

ambiguities.description: The requested degree of fidelity to a real Europlug is not quantified.
candidate_interpretations: Use a simplified recognizable Europlug with a tapered molded body and two round pins.
Model a dimensionally accurate CEE 7/16 Europlug, including standard pin diameter, spacing, body contour, insulation, and strain relief.

ambiguities.description: No specific Europlug manufacturer or body style is identified.
candidate_interpretations: Use a generic symmetric CEE 7/16 body.
Copy the proportions and detailing of a particular commercial Europlug design.

ambiguities.description: The desired orientation of the Europlug body relative to the cable curve is unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Retain the current plug orientation and replace only its form.
Rotate the new plug to present the two round pins most clearly while preserving the cord endpoint.
